say:6:1820821001:1.text: Don't worry, Hilda. I'll lay some traps in case anyone comes snooping around.
say:6:1820821001:1.source_cn: 别担心，希尔达，我会设好陷阱，以防外人闯入。

say:7:1820821002:1.text: Same goes for the barriers. They should be strong enough to keep you from escaping.
say:7:1820821002:1.source_cn: 还有……障碍我也弄好了，你应该没法轻易逃出去。

say:8:1820821003:1.text: Thanks for doing this for me, Bessie. It's so good to have you around.
say:8:1820821003:1.source_cn: 谢谢你帮我这个忙，蓓丝安。有你真好。

say:9:1820821004:1.text: As long as I stay inside, no one will get hurt... I'll feel lonely, sure, but it's better than regretting what I've done and feeling guilty afterward.
say:9:1820821004:1.source_cn: 只要我能一直呆在树洞里，我就不会跑出去伤害大家了……虽...

say:10:1820821005:1.text: But this isn't what I want, Hilda...

say:11:1820821006:1.text: Why... is this happening to everyone? Forgetting who they are, not recognizing their loved ones, and losing their minds...
say:11:1820821006:1.source_cn: 为什么……大家最后都变成了那样？不记得自己是谁，认不出...

say:12:1820821007:1.text: Such is our fate as Graveborn, Bessie. If we go too long without replacing our limbs, our minds slowly erode until madness sets in.
say:12:1820821007:1.source_cn: 这就是亡灵的宿命，蓓丝安。若是太久没有更换肢体，大家的...

say:13:1820821008:1.text: I knew this would happen the moment Bantus imposed the restriction.
say:13:1820821008:1.source_cn: 从班题斯的禁令下达的那一刻，我就知道会这样了。

say:14:1820821009:1.text: ... I'll come visit whenever I can, Hilda. And I made this new <style="highlight">knife</style> for you.
say:14:1820821009:1.source_cn: ……我会经常来看你的，希尔达。还有，我做了一把新的<s...

say:15:1820821010:1.text: So pretty... It's even got magic in it.
say:15:1820821010:1.source_cn: 好漂亮……上面竟然还有魔力。

say:16:1820821011:1.text: I know your old one broke, so I made this new one more durable. I hope it reminds you of me, your best friend.
say:16:1820821011:1.source_cn: 嗯，我知道你手上的那把已经断了，这把更结实耐用。只要看...

say:17:1820821012:0.text: Maybe... keeping your mind active will help you stay lucid.
say:17:1820821012:0.source_cn: 就是……多这样想想，或许能保持精神稳定？

say:18:1820821013:1.text: Thanks, Bessie... I'll treasure this <style="highlight">token</style> of our friendship.
say:18:1820821013:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，蓓丝安……这是你我之间友谊的<style=hi...

say:19:1820821014:1.text: And... I'll try to hold on to what I remember. I may lose everything else... but never you.
say:19:1820821014:1.source_cn: 还有……我会努力守住我的记忆。无论忘记谁，我都不会忘记你……

say:20:1820821015:1.text: Actually, I'd much rather you remember yourself. You'll always be Hilda... the most important person in my life.
say:20:1820821015:1.source_cn: 比起记住我，我更希望你能记住你自己。你永远是希尔达……...

narration:23:180208114:0.text: You see another memory: separated by an obstacle, Hilda expresses her deep gratitude to Bessie.
narration:23:180208114:0.source_cn: 你们再次看到了记忆幻象——相隔一处障碍，希尔达正向蓓丝...
narration:23:180208114:0.male: You see another memory: separated by an obstacle, Hilda expresses her deep gratitude to Bessie.
narration:23:180208114:0.female: You see another memory: separated by an obstacle, Hilda expresses her deep gratitude to Bessie.
